subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Should maintainers require live or focused Discord integration proof before queueing a repair for this Discord post-startup channel-subscription report?
rationale: Current source already contains a generic `channels.discord` restart path, but the reporter describes a newer shipped failure after that path existed, so automation cannot safely pick the missing link without stronger proof.

options.title: Require Discord repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a live Discord or focused integration proof that shows the config edit reaches or misses the restart path and whether the new channel receives inbound events after hot reload.

options.title: Sponsor a source-level investigation
options.body: A maintainer can choose to investigate the reload/restart/provider lifecycle without live proof, accepting that the first PR may need to add diagnostic coverage before a fix is clear.

options.title: Close from generic reload evidence
options.body: Close as already implemented based only on the existing restart path, but this risks repeating the older close that this newer report appears to challenge.

recommendation.title: Require Discord repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a live Discord or focused integration proof that shows the config edit reaches or misses the restart path and whether the new channel receives inbound events after hot reload.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on Discord allowlist/provider behavior and the gateway reload surfaces involved in deciding proof sufficiency.
